fusions.name: Descending Cloud
fusions.desc: Settles on every enemy within 2.5 tiles, which deals 7 damage to each and restores 5 health to you. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Stripped Bare
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A stripping assault that deals 22 damage, uses up every affliction on the target and adds 1.6 times their remaining damage. You heal for 40% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Gleaning Swarm
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a swarm for 15 seconds that bites an enemy within 5 tiles for 4 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 3 health, and you restore 8 health when you loose it.

fusions.name: Gorged Count
fusions.desc: Every kill you make builds a stack, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once and heal you for 3% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
